quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 671,155,492,530 versus KRW 463,505,058,464 in H1 2025, while H1 operating profit fell to KRW 38,373,996,471 from KRW 65,501,193,278. Q2 2026 revenue KRW 349,190,198,259 (Q2 2025: KRW 248,593,861,112) and Q2 operating profit KRW 19,502,426,666 (Q2 2025: KRW 30,202,679,869).

Segment mix, H1 2026: semiconductor segment (parts plus cleaning and coating, i.e. Komico and MiCo Ceramics) revenue KRW 332,761,010 thousand with operating profit KRW 30,218,112 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 296,416,123 thousand revenue, KRW 67,780,493 thousand OP); energy and environment segment (SOFC, industrial boilers, scrubbers, plant) KRW 326,566,259 thousand with OP KRW 9,682,484 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 167,088,935 thousand, loss KRW 2,279,300 thousand); AI / IT services KRW 11,828,224 thousand with an operating loss of KRW 1,496,894 thousand. Semiconductors were 49.58% of H1 revenue versus 64.76% in FY2025.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor revenue KRW 332,761,010 thousand, OP KRW 30,218,112 thousand (H1 2025 OP KRW 67,780,493 thousand); energy & environment KRW 326,566,259 thousand; semiconductors 49.58% of revenue (FY2025 64.76%)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: three external customers each exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026, customer A KRW 81,787,086 thousand, customer B KRW 53,738,063 thousand and customer C KRW 117,630,594 thousand (H1 2025: A KRW 62,684,067 thousand, B KRW 40,240,826 thousand, C none); the note does not name them. The report's main-customer table labels domestic sales of KRW 350,802M (52.27%) as 'Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and others' and export sales of KRW 320,354M (47.73%) as 'Intel, TSMC, Micron and others', but these rows are total domestic and export revenue including non-semiconductor businesses, so no share per chipmaker is disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: customer A KRW 81,787,086 thousand; customer B KRW 53,738,063 thousand; customer C KRW 117,630,594 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and utilisation, H1 2026: semiconductor production capacity (at current average prices) KRW 1,500 hundred million domestic and KRW 751 hundred million overseas for the half-year (FY2025: KRW 3,000 hundred million and KRW 1,502 hundred million). Average utilisation of parts, cleaning and coating was 53.41% domestic (884,754 of 1,656,495 hours) and 51.77% overseas (523,970 of 1,012,098 hours); the SOFC line ran at 86.09%.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor capacity KRW 1,500 hundred million domestic, KRW 751 hundred million overseas (half-year); utilisation 53.41% domestic, 51.77% overseas; SOFC 86.09%

quarterly_data.signal: Capex and R&D: H1 2026 cash paid for property, plant and equipment was KRW 146,565,663,900 and construction in progress reached KRW 319,077M, of which KRW 224,801M is semiconductor overseas (up KRW 43,303M in H1) and KRW 64,048M semiconductor domestic (up KRW 34,627M). H1 R&D spending was KRW 31,352M (4.67% of revenue). On 2026-03-31 MiCo acquired 100% of Hongik Carbon (formerly Sunglim C&G), a maker of graphite parts for semiconductor processes, for KRW 6,805,692 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 PP&E acquisitions KRW 146,565,663,900; construction in progress KRW 319,077M (semiconductor overseas KRW 224,801M); H1 R&D KRW 31,352M (4.67% of revenue)

quarterly_data.signal: Suppliers: H1 2026 raw-material purchases were KRW 99,575M, of which the semiconductor segment bought KRW 13,347M (mounts and other parts, main supplier Nanochem) and the energy and environment segment KRW 86,228M (IS frames and other, main supplier Nanox). Plant-business steel plate comes from POSCO and N2B, and tubes (KRW 14,665,000,000) from Jiangsu Changbao Pulaisen Steel Tube. Semiconductor parts material cost KRW 154,816 per kg and coating material KRW 107,000 per kg.
quarterly_data.figure: raw-material purchases KRW 99,575M (semiconductor KRW 13,347M); parts material KRW 154,816/kg; coating material KRW 107,000/kg

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog for industrial boilers and related plant (energy and environment segment) was KRW 739,383M at June 30, 2026, up from KRW 698,931M at the start of the year, with KRW 325,918M of new contracts and KRW 285,466M recognised as revenue in H1.
quarterly_data.figure: boiler / plant backlog KRW 739,383M; H1 new contracts KRW 325,918M

quarterly_data.signal: SOFC fuel-cell subsidiary MiCo Power: completed investment in 2025 allowing its Anseong plant to produce up to 10MW, plans to build a new Pyeongtaek plant after Q3 2026 for more than 30MW per year of systems, and targets 50MW of stack production after 2027 with plant expansion; it is also developing solid-oxide electrolysis under a 2024 government project (3 years, KRW 129 hundred million). The report says rising AI data-center power demand is sharply lifting SOFC demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Anseong 10MW; Pyeongtaek plant 30MW+ per year after Q3 2026; 50MW stack production after 2027
